title: Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
description:
Implement graceful shutdown for both transit and reader daemons.

## Algorithm (reader — crates/reader/src/main.rs)

1. Keep existing tokio::select! — when any arm fires (CTRL-C, SIGTERM, accept loop exit), fall through.
2. After select! exits, log 'draining N active connections' at INFO (N = MAX_CONNECTIONS - semaphore.available_permits()).
3. Wait for drain: tokio::time::timeout(drain_timeout, semaphore.acquire_many_owned(MAX_CONNECTIONS)).await.
   - If Ok(_): all OwnedSemaphorePermits released (all sessions done). Log 'drained cleanly'. Return from main (exit 0).
   - If Err(_timeout): log 'drain timeout, N connections still open' at WARN. std::process::exit(1).
4. drain_timeout: read from config.limits.drain_timeout_secs (Option<u64>); default 30.
5. Add drain_timeout_secs: Option<u64> to LimitsConfig in crates/reader/src/config.rs.
6. Log 'usenet-ipfs-reader stopped' only after drain completes.

## Algorithm (transit — crates/transit/src/main.rs)

Transit has a semaphore in accept_loop and an ingestion task. On shutdown:
1. Check if accept_loop uses a semaphore; if not, add one matching the max_connections pattern from reader.
2. Signal fires → select! exits. Log 'draining'.
3. Drop the ingestion_sender channel end. This closes the channel. The ingestion task will drain remaining articles then exit.
4. Await ingestion_task_handle (saved JoinHandle from tokio::spawn at line ~654) with drain_timeout.
5. Drain peer sessions via semaphore same as reader.
6. If drain_timeout exceeded: exit(1). On clean: implicit exit(0).
7. Add drain_timeout_secs to TransitConfig.

## Defensive programming rules
- Never unwrap() a semaphore acquire in drain path — the acquire_many_owned will only fail if semaphore is closed. Document this.
- drain_timeout default of 30s is a floor; operators must set TimeoutStopSec=90 in systemd.
- Exit codes: 0=clean, 1=timeout forced.
- Do not log key material on shutdown path.
- Do not skip drain if max_connections is 0 (guard against divide-by-zero / acquire_many(0)).

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo test --workspace passes
- SIGTERM with no active connections: reader exits in < 2s
- SIGTERM with active connection: semaphore drain path executes (verified by log output in test)
- Config field drain_timeout_secs parses correctly from TOML
